instruction.sound: ssml: Spell the word. <break time='500ms'/> budget.

atoms.word: b u d g e t

feedback.end: A budget is a plan for saving and spending money. Keeping track of exactly how much money you have helps to make sure you spend your money wisely.

instruction.text: A good budget keeps track of several things. Listen to the sound and select the correct part of the budget.

feedback.end: Your earnings are all the money you have received since you did your last budget.
Your budget should include all the things you plan to spend your money on.

instruction.text: Look at the budget again. Can this person afford all the things they are planning to buy?

hint.text: Look at the totals in both sections. Have they earned enough money?

feedback.end: It is a good idea to keep track of how much money you have in total, so you know what you can afford.

instruction.text: When we do not have enough money to buy everything we want and need, it is very important that we take care of our needs first. Select the two needs shown on the budget.

hint.text: Remember, needs are things we must have in order to survive.

instruction.text: This is a much wiser budget. Here, the leftover money from the earnings can be added to their savings. In the next level, you will learn more about saving!
